Configure group examination

Source: R/examination-control.R
examination_control.Rd

examination_control() validates the bounded execution, residual-geometry, review, staging, and numerical settings used by examine_group(). Keeping these settings in a typed object makes defaults visible and reproducible.

Usage

examination_control(
  block_size = 1024L,
  geometry = list(rank = 32L, oversample = 8L, cap = 8, balance_contrasts = TRUE,
    stability_replicates = 2L),
  review = list(surprise = list(energy_threshold = 2.5, tail_threshold = 0.01,
    residual_threshold = 3), influence = list(energy_threshold = 1, max_abs_threshold =
    2), quality = list(coverage_fraction = list(direction = "low", threshold = 0.8)),
    min_stability = 0.7),
  exact_refit_n = 5L,
  retain_n = 5L,
  staging = list(tempdir = NULL),
  tolerance = list(rank = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps), leverage = 1e-08, degeneracy =
    1e-12)
)

Arguments

block_size

Positive number of samples read per scan block.

geometry

Named list controlling the deterministic low-rank residual representation. Supported entries are rank, oversample, cap, balance_contrasts, and stability_replicates.

review

Named list controlling review status. Supported entries are surprise, influence, quality, and min_stability.

exact_refit_n

Number of selected random-effects cases eligible for an exact heterogeneity refit.

retain_n

Number of highest-priority subjects retained for localization when no explicit retain set is supplied.

staging

Named list with optional tempdir. Staging stores are always removed on success or failure.

tolerance

Named list of numerical tolerances: rank, leverage, and degeneracy.

Value

An object of class gds_examination_control.
